CustomField.description: Comma-separated Opportunity stage API names reps may choose on Update Opportunity in LINE. Blank = all active open stages (closing a deal is done in Salesforce). Closed stages are never offered.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Stages reps may choose from LINE, comma-separated (e.g. 01. Before 1st MTG,02. Early Stage). Blank = all open stages.
CustomField.label: Opportunity Stages
